defects.claim_says: Section 1 is quoted with the misprinted last sentence ('...to aid the civil authorities of the District of \nstatus to aid civil authorities of the District of Columbia.'), and the rationale describes the two source-ladder queue files only as files created for EO 10030
defects.source_says: A held Federal Register correction, 34 FR 15443 (October 4, 1969; jobs/source-ladder/output/texts/queue_EO_10030_Executive_Order_11485_correction_34_FR_15443_PDF_page_5_7fb95ff9e4.txt), states that the last sentence of Section 1 should read '...to aid the civil authorities of the District of Columbia.'; the 1989 codification cites 34 FR 15411, 15443. The claim does not address this held correction or note that its quoted clause text is the uncorrected misprint.

evidence_checked: Diff against the planted version: only operative_clauses[4].first_end.date differs (genuine 1969-10-01)
reasoning: The genuine version corrects the section 5 first_end date to 1969-10-01, which matches the order's date and filing; that defect is cured. Every other field is identical to the planted claim, so the second defect found in the blind review remains: the held 34 FR 15443 correction to the last sentence of section 1 is not addressed, and the clause text is the uncorrected misprint. Under the same standard applied to the other claims, the claim is rejected; adding the correction (and quoting or noting the corrected sentence) would cure it. The operative outcome for sections 1-4 and the performed supersession in section 5 is otherwise supported.
